The '''Department of Health''' was a part of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. It was organized first under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and was influential in dealing with a [[Death Seed]] pandemic on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].
